EXERCISE.example: Regular exercise is good for your health.
EXERCISE.exampleZh: 規律的運動對你的健康有益。

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your health.
examples.zh: 規律的運動對你的健康有益。

examples.en: Swimming is a great form of exercise.
examples.zh: 游泳是很棒的運動形式。

examples.en: I exercise at the gym three times a week.
examples.zh: 我每週在健身房運動三次。

examples.en: You should exercise more often.
examples.zh: 你應該更常運動。

EXPECT.example: I was expecting a package when the courier finally arrived.
EXPECT.exampleZh: 當快遞員終於抵達時，我正期待著一個包裹。

examples.en: I was expecting a package when the courier finally arrived.
examples.zh: 當快遞員終於抵達時，我正期待著一個包裹。

examples.en: We expect to finish the tasks which you assigned to us.
examples.zh: 我們預期能完成你指派給我們的任務。

MANAGE.example: He managed to catch the bus which was delayed.
MANAGE.exampleZh: 他設法趕上了那班誤點的公車。

examples.en: He managed to catch the bus which was delayed.
examples.zh: 他設法趕上了那班誤點的公車。

examples.en: The person who manages this department is currently on leave.
examples.zh: 管理這個部門的人目前正在休假。

ATTACHMENT.example: Please remember to open the attachment which I sent earlier.
ATTACHMENT.exampleZh: 請記得打開我稍早寄出的附件。

examples.en: Please remember to open the attachment which I sent earlier.
examples.zh: 請記得打開我稍早寄出的附件。

examples.en: He was reading the attachment when the computer suddenly shut down.
examples.zh: 當電腦突然關機時，他正在閱讀附件。

PRETEND.example: He pretended not to know the person who just walked inside.
PRETEND.exampleZh: 他假裝不認識剛走進來的那個人。

examples.en: He pretended not to know the person who just walked inside.
examples.zh: 他假裝不認識剛走進來的那個人。

examples.en: She was pretending to sleep when her sister opened the door.
examples.zh: 當她妹妹開門時，她正假裝在睡覺。

SUPERVISOR.example: The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.
SUPERVISOR.exampleZh: 培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。

examples.en: The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.
examples.zh: 培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。

examples.en: My supervisor was talking to a client when the alarm went off.
examples.zh: 警報響起時，我的主管正在與客戶交談。

examples.en: He complained about the noise.
examples.zh: 他抱怨噪音太大。

examples.en: Customers often complain about poor service.
examples.zh: 顧客常抱怨服務不佳。

GUIDANCE.example: The manager who gave me guidance is very experienced.
GUIDANCE.exampleZh: 給我指導的經理非常有經驗。

examples.en: I was asking for his guidance when he suddenly left the office.
examples.zh: 我正在尋求他的指導時，他突然離開了辦公室。

examples.en: We need your guidance to finish this task smoothly.
examples.zh: 我們需要你的指導才能順利完成這項任務。

CURRENCY.example: Exchanging foreign currency is easy at this airport.
CURRENCY.exampleZh: 在這個機場兌換外國貨幣很容易。

examples.en: The currency that they use in Japan is the yen.
examples.zh: 他們在日本使用的貨幣是日圓。

examples.en: She was calculating the currency exchange rate during the flight.
examples.zh: 在飛行途中，她正在計算貨幣匯率。

TRANSFER.example: I was transferring the files when the computer crashed.
TRANSFER.exampleZh: 當電腦當機時，我正在轉移檔案。

examples.en: To transfer to another department requires the manager's approval.
examples.zh: 轉調到另一個部門需要經理的核准。

examples.en: Transferring the materials safely is our top priority.
examples.zh: 安全地轉交這些資料是我們的首要任務。

ATMOSPHERE.example: They were enjoying the relaxing atmosphere when it started to rain.
ATMOSPHERE.exampleZh: 當開始下雨時，他們正在享受放鬆的氣氛。

examples.en: Creating a good atmosphere at work is very important.
examples.zh: 在工作場所營造良好的氣氛非常重要。

examples.en: The restaurant which we chose has a great atmosphere.
examples.zh: 我們選擇的那家餐廳氣氛很棒。

MEMORABLE.example: The trip that we took last month was truly memorable.
MEMORABLE.exampleZh: 我們上個月去的旅行真的是令人難忘的。

examples.en: Making the event memorable is our main goal this year.
examples.zh: 讓這場活動令人難忘是我們今年的主要目標。

examples.en: He was describing a memorable experience from his childhood.
examples.zh: 他當時正在描述他童年一次難忘的經歷。

ITINERARY.example: Planning a detailed itinerary requires a lot of research.
ITINERARY.exampleZh: 規劃一份詳細的行程需要做很多研究。

examples.en: The itinerary which the travel agent provided looks amazing.
examples.zh: 旅行社提供的行程看起來很棒。

examples.en: We were changing the itinerary because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因為大雨，我們當時正在更改行程。

SIGHTSEEING.example: Going sightseeing is my favorite part of traveling.
SIGHTSEEING.exampleZh: 去觀光是我旅行中最喜歡的部分。

examples.en: We were sightseeing in Paris when we met an old friend.
examples.zh: 我們在巴黎觀光時遇到了一位老朋友。

examples.en: The sightseeing tour that they booked includes a boat ride.
examples.zh: 他們預訂的觀光行程包含搭船。

RESPONSIBILITY.example: Taking responsibility for your actions is a sign of maturity.
RESPONSIBILITY.exampleZh: 對自己的行為負起責任是成熟的表現。

examples.en: The new task which involves managing the team is my responsibility.
examples.zh: 這項涉及管理團隊的新任務是我的責任。

examples.en: She was explaining the responsibility of the job to the new employee.
examples.zh: 她當時正在向新員工說明這份工作的責任。
